rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase (3/1/26 - 2/28/27)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%. The dollar amount is calculated by multiplying the tenant's base rent by .016.
rules.citation: Annual Rent Increase for 3/1/26 - 2/28/27 Announced (SF Rent Board)
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
